games.description: A full run of the 1993 sequel: Sark rolls straight out of Jack in the Dark, fights through Hell's Kitchen as Edward Carnby, wrestles with the game's adventure-puzzle logic, takes over Grace Saunders for an extended escape and infiltration sequence, then boards the Flying Dutchman and finishes One-Eyed Jack.
games.title: Alone in the Dark 2

games.description: A three-session archive of Sark's 1995 Western-horror run: a brief first look after finishing Alone in the Dark 2, followed by a fresh Slaughter Gulch playthrough that continues through Carnby's bizarre resurrection, the radioactive underground complex, Emily Hartwood's rescue, and the final showdown with Jed Stone.
games.title: Alone in the Dark 3

games.description: A solo playthrough of the 1993 Alone in the Dark preview. Sark guides Grace through the toy shop, works out the possessed-toy puzzles and repeats the mirror sequence to free Santa.
